title: Nvidia has officially confirmed that the 5090 is not discontinued and will continue shipping.
hook_before: Nvidia is officially continuing production of the RTX 5090.
script:
The RTX fifty-ninety is staying, not being discontinued. Nvidia confirmed the card remains in its active lineup.
The company confirmed the card remains in its active lineup.
This announcement follows widespread rumors of a sudden discontinuation.
The RTX 5090 remains the flagship choice for high-end AI processing.
Shoppers can expect units to keep hitting store shelves.
